en: Vintage Romanian postcard. Front: a sepia decorative card with floral border and an oval portrait of a woman; printed Romanian caption reads "Poetii si Autorii Români" and the name "Carmen Sylva – Reine de Roumanie," with publisher credit along the left margin. Handwritten message in French appears at the bottom with a date. Back: UPU layout headed "ROMANIA CARTE POSTALE" with a red 10 BANI Romanian stamp canceled "BUCURESCI 7 MAI," transit/arrival marks, and an address to La Haye (The Hague), Netherlands; a blue library stamp from Zaltbommel is also present.
